```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "datasets/uwmadison.sqlite3")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(connection = "conn")
```

### 1. Conexão com o banco de dados

```{r}
dbListTables(conn)
```

### 2. Professores que lecionaram disciplinas de Estatística

```{sql}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS N_PROFESSORES
FROM subjects s
INNER JOIN subject_memberships sm ON sm.subject_code = s.code
INNER JOIN sections sec ON sec.course_offering_uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
INNER JOIN teachings t ON t.section_uuid = sec.uuid
INNER JOIN instructors i ON i.id = t.instructor_id
WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT';
```

```{sql}
SELECT DISTINCT i.id AS ID, i.name AS PROFESSOR
FROM subjects s
INNER JOIN subject_memberships sm ON sm.subject_code = s.code
INNER JOIN sections sec ON sec.course_offering_uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
INNER JOIN teachings t ON t.section_uuid = sec.uuid
INNER JOIN instructors i ON i.id = t.instructor_id
WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
ORDER BY i.name;
```

### 3. Nota média (GPA) de cada oferecimento

```{sql}
SELECT gd.course_offering_uuid AS OFERECIMENTO,
       SUM(gd.a_count*4.0 + gd.ab_count*3.5 + gd.b_count*3.0 + gd.bc_count*2.5
           + gd.c_count*2.0 + gd.d_count*1.0 + gd.f_count*0.0)
       / SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
             + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS GPA
FROM grade_distributions gd
INNER JOIN subject_memberships sm
        ON sm.course_offering_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
INNER JOIN subjects s ON s.code = sm.subject_code
WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
GROUP BY gd.course_offering_uuid
HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
           + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
ORDER BY GPA;
```

#### Professor mais difícil

```{sql}
WITH stat_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sm.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM subject_memberships sm
  INNER JOIN subjects s ON s.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
),
gpa_off AS (
  SELECT gd.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid,
         SUM(gd.a_count*4.0 + gd.ab_count*3.5 + gd.b_count*3.0 + gd.bc_count*2.5
             + gd.c_count*2.0 + gd.d_count*1.0 + gd.f_count*0.0)
         / SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
               + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS gpa
  FROM grade_distributions gd
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  GROUP BY gd.course_offering_uuid
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
             + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
),
prof_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.instructor_id AS iid, sec.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM teachings t
  INNER JOIN sections sec ON sec.uuid = t.section_uuid
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = sec.course_offering_uuid
)
SELECT i.name AS PROFESSOR, AVG(g.gpa) AS GPA_MEDIO
FROM prof_off p
INNER JOIN gpa_off g ON g.off_uuid = p.off_uuid
INNER JOIN instructors i ON i.id = p.iid
GROUP BY p.iid, i.name
ORDER BY GPA_MEDIO ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

#### Professor mais fácil

```{sql}
WITH stat_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sm.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM subject_memberships sm
  INNER JOIN subjects s ON s.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
),
gpa_off AS (
  SELECT gd.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid,
         SUM(gd.a_count*4.0 + gd.ab_count*3.5 + gd.b_count*3.0 + gd.bc_count*2.5
             + gd.c_count*2.0 + gd.d_count*1.0 + gd.f_count*0.0)
         / SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
               + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS gpa
  FROM grade_distributions gd
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  GROUP BY gd.course_offering_uuid
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
             + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
),
prof_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.instructor_id AS iid, sec.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM teachings t
  INNER JOIN sections sec ON sec.uuid = t.section_uuid
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = sec.course_offering_uuid
)
SELECT i.name AS PROFESSOR, AVG(g.gpa) AS GPA_MEDIO
FROM prof_off p
INNER JOIN gpa_off g ON g.off_uuid = p.off_uuid
INNER JOIN instructors i ON i.id = p.iid
GROUP BY p.iid, i.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY GPA_MEDIO DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

#### Disciplina mais difícil

```{sql}
WITH stat_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sm.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM subject_memberships sm
  INNER JOIN subjects s ON s.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
),
gpa_off AS (
  SELECT gd.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid,
         SUM(gd.a_count*4.0 + gd.ab_count*3.5 + gd.b_count*3.0 + gd.bc_count*2.5
             + gd.c_count*2.0 + gd.d_count*1.0 + gd.f_count*0.0)
         / SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
               + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS gpa
  FROM grade_distributions gd
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  GROUP BY gd.course_offering_uuid
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
             + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
)
SELECT c.number AS NUMERO, c.name AS DISCIPLINA, AVG(g.gpa) AS GPA_MEDIO
FROM gpa_off g
INNER JOIN course_offerings co ON co.uuid = g.off_uuid
INNER JOIN courses c ON c.uuid = co.course_uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.number, c.name
ORDER BY GPA_MEDIO ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

#### Disciplina mais fácil

```{sql}
WITH stat_off AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sm.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid
  FROM subject_memberships sm
  INNER JOIN subjects s ON s.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
),
gpa_off AS (
  SELECT gd.course_offering_uuid AS off_uuid,

             + gd.c_count*2.0 + gd.d_count*1.0 + gd.f_count*0.0)
         / SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
               + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS gpa
  FROM grade_distributions gd
  INNER JOIN stat_off so ON so.off_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  GROUP BY gd.course_offering_uuid
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
             + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
)
SELECT c.number AS NUMERO, c.name AS DISCIPLINA, AVG(g.gpa) AS GPA_MEDIO
FROM gpa_off g
INNER JOIN course_offerings co ON co.uuid = g.off_uuid
INNER JOIN courses c ON c.uuid = co.course_uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.number, c.name
```
